name: The Drift
summary: You reached the Loom sworn to nobody and left it weaving. The Choir sings on under the floor; the factions circle; the Shards keep stirring. Nothing ended, which is a kind of ending.

sera.alive: Sera keeps the yard gate. She has stopped counting the villages.
sera.dead: Sera is buried under the catwalk by the Beacon, facing the gate.

kaj7.alive: Kaj-7 still listens. Lately the signal has started listening back.
kaj7.dead: Kaj-7's chassis stands in the Workshop. Nobody has the heart to strip it.

dax.alive: Dax went back to the vault. The seal held; nobody knows for how long.
dax.dead: Dax's family got the news from a stranger. The seal held.
